add_constructor: add a board game environment constructor to the global registry using the add function
get_constructor: get a registered board game environment constructor by name using the get_constructor function
get_all_names: get all registered board game environment names using the get_all_names function
get_names_by_tag: get board game environment names filtered by tag using the get_names_by_tag function
done_importing_tasks: call done_importing_tasks to allow overriding constructor names for hot-reloading environments
